nodes.description: PauserRole.isPauser(address) view, checks Roles.Role membership via _pausers.has(account).
PauserRole.addPauser(address) guarded by onlyPauser; adds account to _pausers.
PauserRole.renouncePauser() removes msg.sender from _pausers.
Ownable.owner() view returns the private _owner state variable.
Ownable.isOwner() view compares msg.sender to _owner; basis of the onlyOwner modifier.
Ownable.renounceOwnership() onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner, delegates to _transferOwnership.
Ownable._transferOwnership(address) internal, requires non-zero and writes _owner.
ERC20._approveOwner(address,uint) onlyOwner, writes _allowed[spender][owner] = value.
ERC20.allowance(address,address) view returns _allowed[owner][spender].
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint) onlyOwner, transfers when _allowed[from][msg.sender] > 0 then decrements allowance.
ERC20._transfer internal, moves balances with SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
ERC20._mint internal, increases _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._burn internal, decreases _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._burnFrom internal, decrements _allowed[account][msg.sender] then burns.
ERC20Burnable.burn(uint) burns msg.sender balance.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(address,uint) delegates to _burnFrom.
Pausable.pause() onlyPauser whenNotPaused, sets _paused = true.
Pausable.unpause() onlyPauser whenPaused, sets _paused = false.
Migrations.setCompleted(uint) restricted, writes last_completed_migration.
Migrations.upgrade(address) restricted, instantiates caller-supplied address and calls setCompleted on it.
ELB1 constructor, sets _building_address and mints totalsupply * 10**decimals to owner().
ELB1.transfer(address,uint) ignores 'to' and forwards msg.sender funds to owner().
ELB1.transferOwner(address,uint) onlyOwner, transfers owner balance to recipient and self-approves recipient.
ELB1.buildingAddress() view returns _building_address.
SafeMath.add (and sibling mul/div/sub/mod) overflow/underflow checked arithmetic helpers.
Roles.Role private _pausers mapping of pauser bearers.
address private _owner, privileged owner account.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowed allowances.
uint256 private _totalSupply total token supply.
Roles.Role private _minters mapping of minter bearers.
bool private _paused pause flag.
string private _name token name.
string private _symbol token symbol.
uint8 private _decimals token decimals.
address public owner of the Migrations contract, set to msg.sender in constructor.
uint public last_completed_migration migration counter.
string private _building_address hardcoded office address string.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller identity used across ownership, allowance and transfer logic.
ELB1.transfer redirects the caller's tokens to owner() instead of the declared 'to' recipient.
transferFrom authorizes the transfer when allowance is merely > 0 rather than >= value, allowing an unlimited spend from a tiny allowance.
Migrations.upgrade performs an external call to a caller supplied contract address.
ELB1 constructor computes totalsupply * 10 ** uint(decimals) without SafeMath, risking overflow.
address account parameter of PauserRole.addPauser/_addPauser.
address newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
address spender parameter of ERC20._approveOwner, indexes _allowed.
uint value parameter of ERC20._approveOwner, written into _allowed.
address from parameter of ERC20.transferFrom, debited source.
address to parameter of ERC20.transferFrom, credited destination.
uint value parameter of ERC20.transferFrom, amount transferred and deducted from allowance.
address to parameter of ELB1.transfer that is silently ignored by the implementation.
uint amount parameter of ELB1.transfer, amount forwarded to owner().
address recipient parameter of ELB1.transferOwner.
uint amount parameter of ELB1.transferOwner.
string name parameter of the ELB1 constructor forwarded to ERC20Detailed.
string symbol parameter of the ELB1 constructor forwarded to ERC20Detailed.
uint8 decimals parameter of the ELB1 constructor, used as exponent in mint math.
uint256 totalsupply parameter of the ELB1 constructor multiplied before minting.
uint completed parameter of Migrations.setCompleted.
address new_address parameter of Migrations.upgrade, used as external call target.
address from parameter of ERC20Burnable.burnFrom.
uint value parameter of ERC20Burnable.burnFrom.
local Migrations upgraded instance created from new_address in Migrations.upgrade.
local address owner caching owner() inside ERC20._approveOwner.

Caller funds controlled by msg.sender are redirected to owner() by the unsafe operation.
ELB1.transfer unconditionally executes the redirect-to-owner operation.
The redirect invokes ERC20._transfer with owner() as the destination.
The 'to' parameter of ELB1.transfer is accepted but never used.
The amount parameter flows into ELB1.transfer.
transferFrom reads msg.sender as the spender for the allowance lookup.
The 'from' parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom.
The 'value' parameter flows into ERC20.transferFrom.
Allowance guard checks only _allowed > 0 rather than >= value before the subtraction.
transferFrom invokes internal ERC20._transfer.
transferFrom mutates the _allowed allowance mapping.
ERC20._approveOwner writes the _allowed mapping.
The spender parameter is the first index written into _allowed.
The value parameter is written into _allowed.
_approveOwner reads the owner address derived from _owner.
Local owner caches the owner() result inside _approveOwner.
isOwner reads the _owner state variable.
isOwner compares msg.sender against _owner.
owner() returns _owner.

onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership is enforced through isOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on _approveOwner is enforced through isOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on transferFrom is enforced through isOwner.

onlyOwner modifier on transferOwner is enforced through isOwner.

The newOwner parameter flows into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership overwrites _owner.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner.
renouncePauser removes an entry from _pausers.
renouncePauser removes msg.sender from the pauser set.
The account parameter is consumed by addPauser.
The account parameter is written into _pausers.
onlyPauser gate on addPauser is enforced through isPauser(msg.sender).
isPauser is queried with msg.sender by the modifier.
The spender parameter indexes the _allowed storage mapping.
transferOwner calls _transfer(owner(), recipient, amount).
transferOwner calls _approveOwner(recipient, amount).
The recipient parameter flows into transferOwner.
The amount parameter flows into transferOwner.

_transfer mutates the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burnFrom delegates to _burn.
_burnFrom decrements the _allowed allowance.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom delegates to _burnFrom.
The from parameter flows into burnFrom.
The value parameter flows into burnFrom.
burn calls _burn(msg.sender, value).
burn destroys the msg.sender balance.
The constructor mints the initial supply via _mint.
The constructor mints to owner()/msg.sender.
The totalsupply parameter feeds the unchecked scaling multiplication.
The constructor performs unchecked arithmetic before minting.
The decimals parameter is used as the exponent in the scaling expression.
The constructor writes the _building_address state variable.
The name parameter is forwarded to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
The symbol parameter is forwarded to the ERC20Detailed constructor.
upgrade performs an external call to an address supplied by the caller.
The new_address parameter flows into Migrations.upgrade.
The caller-supplied address becomes the target of the external call.
The local upgraded instance is used to perform the external invocation.
Migrations.upgrade invokes setCompleted on the target contract address.
setCompleted writes last_completed_migration.
The completed parameter flows into setCompleted.
pause reads the _paused flag via the whenNotPaused modifier.
pause sets _paused to true.
unpause reads the _paused flag via the whenPaused modifier.
unpause sets _paused to false.

onlyPauser gate on unpause is enforced through isPauser(msg.sender).

SafeMath sub/add guard the balance arithmetic inside _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter exists only to be consumed by addPauser/_addPauser.
newOwner is only meaningful as the argument of _transferOwnership.
spender is only used as the index written by _approveOwner.
value is only used as the allowance amount written by _approveOwner.
from is only used as the debited account of transferFrom.
to is only used as the credited account of transferFrom.
value is only used as the transferred amount of transferFrom.
the to parameter belongs exclusively to ELB1.transfer where it is ignored.
amount is only used as the transferred quantity of ELB1.transfer.
recipient is only used as the destination of transferOwner.
amount is only used as the transferred quantity of transferOwner.
name is consumed only by the ELB1 constructor when forwarding to ERC20Detailed.
symbol is consumed only by the ELB1 constructor when forwarding to ERC20Detailed.
decimals is consumed only by the ELB1 constructor as the scaling exponent.
totalsupply is the operand of the unchecked constructor multiplication.
completed is only used as the value assigned by setCompleted.
new_address is the caller-controlled target of the external call.
from is only used as the burn source of burnFrom.
value is only used as the burned quantity of burnFrom.
the upgraded local instance exists only inside Migrations.upgrade.
the local owner cache exists only inside ERC20._approveOwner.
